helpContextMenuDesc1.message: Due to API limitations, a unified toggle command for the side panel is not available, so it is split into two separate menu commands: Open Side Panel and Close Side Panel.

helpIncognitoDesc1.message: Without the **Allow in incognito** option enabled, whether triggered from the side panel or the context menu, it will always open content in new incognito window. Therefore, to ensure it opens in an existing incognito window, please enable the **Allow in incognito** option in chrome://extensions for this extension.

helpIncognitoDesc2.message: When the **Allow in incognito** option is enabled, after clicking the **Open in new incognito tab** button or selecting **Send Selected Text To New Incognito Tab / Window** from the context menu, you may notice that the existing incognito window does not come to the foreground immediately. This is expected behavior, because the new incognito tab has already been opened in the background. Please check all open browser windows.

helpIncognitoNote.message: In Settings, enable the **Enable Incognito Features** option to use incognito-related features.

helpSearchEngineDesc.message: By default, the search engine configured in your browser is used. You can turn on **Temporarily Enable A Custom Search Engine** in the side panel settings to choose a preferred engine; this setting only applies to the current side panel session and resets when the side panel is closed. Due to API limitations, the context menu option **Send Selected Text To New Incognito Tab / Window** always uses Google search.

helpSettingsDesc.message: You can manage features by category in the side panel settings: enable incognito and new-window opening (non-incognito), customize context menu items, configure text staging and the search engine, and reset all settings.
